segments.t: Thinking on his feet to salvage the situation, Chef Barinov claims he was purposely holding back his congratulations until tonight so he would not spoil his big birthday surprise. Though skeptical, Elena agrees to wait and see what he has prepared for the evening.
Витя, это фиаско!
Держусь, тебя не поздравляю.
А ты не можешь потерпеть до вечера!
То есть ты подготовил мне сюрприз?
Вот именно, сюрприз!
Просто я не верю.
Обычно у тебя сюрпризы случаются сами собой.
Потом ты просто просишь за них прощения.
Вот увидим вечером!
Спасибо большое, очень приятно.
Я позвоню и отметим.
До вечера, любимая!
Now let's go back through their conversation line by line and unpack the Russian phrasing.
Витя, это фиаско!
'Vitya, this is a fiasco!' Insisting that this is a fiasco shows Barinov is not backing down.
Держусь, тебя не поздравляю.

'I am holding back, not congratulating you.' Realizing that he is holding back not congratulating Elena changes how Barinov handles the situation. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
А ты не можешь потерпеть до вечера!

'And you cannot be patient until evening!' Declaring that Elena cannot be patient until evening brings Barinov's temper right to the surface. Using the informal "you" shows how direct and unfiltered their kitchen relationship is.
То есть ты подготовил мне сюрприз?
'So you prepared a surprise for me?' With the secret and truth hanging in the air, Elena puts Barinov on the spot.
Вот именно, сюрприз!
'Precisely, a surprise!' Over the situation and the secret, Barinov lets his real feelings show. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Просто я не верю.
'I simply do not believe it.' Mentioning that she simply does not believe it moves the talk in a new direction.
Обычно у тебя сюрпризы случаются сами собой.
'Usually your surprises happen by themselves.' Elena reminds Barinov that usually Barinov's surprises happen by themselves before the moment passes.
Потом ты просто просишь за них прощения.

'Then you simply ask forgiveness for them.' Around the truth and surprise, Elena sets a calm, everyday tone with Barinov. Speaking with the close, informal "you" strips away any polite distance between them.
Вот увидим вечером!
'Well we will see tonight!' Once they will see tonight, Barinov makes sure Elena hears every word. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat.
Спасибо большое, очень приятно.
'Thank you very much, that is very nice.' Elena mentions that very much that is very nice so Barinov sees what is at stake.
Я позвоню и отметим.
'I will call and we will celebrate.' Claiming that she will call and they will celebrate sounds confident, even if Barinov has doubts.
До вечера, любимая!

'Until evening, darling!' With the shift and surprise at stake, Barinov reacts without holding back. Russian puts the key word right up front so his emotion lands on the first beat. Alright, let's hear the entire conversation one more time from start to finish.
Витя, это фиаско!
Держусь, тебя не поздравляю.
А ты не можешь потерпеть до вечера!
То есть ты подготовил мне сюрприз?
Вот именно, сюрприз!
Просто я не верю.
Обычно у тебя сюрпризы случаются сами собой.
Потом ты просто просишь за них прощения.
Вот увидим вечером!
Спасибо большое, очень приятно.
Я позвоню и отметим.
До вечера, любимая!
That brings Viktor's narrow escape to a close. Notice how Elena jokes that Viktor's surprises usually happen by accident and end with him asking for forgiveness. See you next time!
Хорошего дня!
